settings.cellStyleFunction:
var c = ({CRITICAL:'#D32F2F', MAJOR:'#F57C00', MINOR:'#FFA000', WARNING:'#FBC02D', INDETERMINATE:'#757575'})[value] || '#000';
return {color: c, fontWeight: 600};

settings.cellStyleFunction: var v = Number(value); return v > 0 ? {color:'#F57C00', fontWeight:600} : {};
